system.description:
Brawlers from the hill-country wrestling schools, who train with weight and fight with force rather than finesse.

  • Lift and Throw: a creature you are grappling takes your primary unarmed damage at the start of each of its turns. When you throw a grappled foe, it takes your primary unarmed damage and falls Prone.
    • 9th level: you may throw it up to 10ft into another creature; both take your primary unarmed damage.
  • Heavy Hands: Strength counts as one of your two key attributes (in place of Dexterity), and you may use it instead of Dexterity for Deflect, and instead of Wisdom for Parrying Stance. War hammers, heavy maces, mauls, battle axes, heavy flails and halberds count as monk weapons for you.
